name: Second item
description: The second item, also known as the second Starflash, was a superweapon similar to the previous Starflash superweapon that the Chiss Ascendancy used in a final battle against an unknown enemy around 4300 BBY. The second Starflash superweapon was acquired by the Stybla family around 285 BBY, and was unknown to almost all Chiss.

data.name: Second item
data.size: Small enough to be loaded into a ship, but large enough to be operated by 20 people
data.purpose: To send a massive blast of energy at a star, which would then cause an even larger blast back
